name: VyStar Credit Union
notes: Researched from public vystarcu.org pages. The live site answers scripted requests with a Radware/ShieldSquare bot challenge (not bypassed), so the page text was read from Internet Archive copies of the same URLs (make-loan-payment 2026-04-16, e-statements 2026-06-07, hardship-assistance 2026-04-20, enrollment-and-login 2026-05-13). Loans are paid by Internal or External Transfer in Online & Mobile Banking (Pay & Transfer on desktop, Transfers in the app; amount and frequency). Payments from another institution without logging in: "Make a VyStar Payment" (BillMatrix/Fiserv guest page; fee and accepted methods not stated on VyStar pages). External transfers are free. Magic*Touch phone payments transfer from VyStar accounts only (904-777-6001 / 800-235-6289, member number + PIN). Automatic Funds Transfer Service (AFTS: loans except credit cards) is set up by phone (904-777-6000 or 800-445-6289 option 9) or at a branch. Hardship: Skip A Pay ($15/month, up to 3 months, consumer loans, 6 payments first), Hardship Deferment (11-60 days past due), Due Date Change - each requested with a DocuSign form, 3-5 business days; no online payment plan (payment_arrangement unsupported). Due-date changes cannot be modelled (open tier-1 request). Statements: Online & Mobile Banking enrollment gives online statements automatically; members can also get mail by toggling e-Statements under Profile & Settings > Statements Delivery (paperless modelled as the family toggle). Enrollment needs member number, SSN/Tax ID, savings account and ZIP, then username/password and a one-time passcode. Online methods bank only (inferred). Review 2026-10-10: the live make-loan-payment page loaded without a challenge for the reviewer and states that Make a VyStar Payment carries a $7.50 fee (now fees.guestBankCents/guestCardCents 750; accepted guest methods still not stated, family default kept).

pay_online.note: Pay your loan by Internal Transfer from a VyStar account or External Transfer from another institution; external transfers are free.

guest_pay.note: Make a VyStar Payment pays a VyStar loan from an account at another financial institution without logging in. A $7.50 fee applies to each payment.

autopay.note: Set a frequency on a transfer to repeat it. Automatic Funds Transfer Service (all loans except credit cards) is set up by calling 904-777-6000 or 800-445-6289, option 9, or at a branch.

payment_arrangement.note: VyStar has no online payment plan. Skip A Pay, Hardship Deferment and Due Date Change are requested with a short form; call 904-777-6000 or 800-445-6289 for help.

pay_by_phone.note: Magic*Touch, our voice response line, moves money from your VyStar checking, savings or money market account to your loan. Call 904-777-6001 or 800-235-6289 and use your member number and Magic*Touch PIN.

help.title: How to make a loan payment
paragraphs: Pay your loan in Online & Mobile Banking by moving money from a VyStar savings, checking or money market account, or from your account at another institution. It works like any other transfer, any time, in any amount.

Log in, select Pay & Transfer on a computer (Transfers in the VyStar Mobile app), choose Internal or External Transfer, pick the loan in the To section, enter the amount and frequency, then continue and finish.

Without logging in, Make a VyStar Payment takes a payment from an account at another institution for a $7.50 fee; internal and external transfers in Online & Mobile Banking are free. You can also call Magic*Touch at 904-777-6001 or 800-235-6289, or mail a check payable to VyStar Credit Union to P.O. Box 45085, Jacksonville, FL 32232-5085 (credit cards: P.O. Box 71050, Charlotte, NC 28272-1050).

help.title: Recurring and automatic loan payments
paragraphs: Choose a frequency when you set up a transfer in Online & Mobile Banking and the payment repeats on that schedule.

With the Automatic Funds Transfer Service, loan payments (except credit cards) are deducted from your VyStar account automatically; just keep enough money in the account. Call 904-777-6000 or 800-445-6289, option 9, or visit a branch to set it up.

help.title: Hardship and loan assistance
paragraphs: VyStar can adjust payment dates or pause payments for a while. Each option is requested with a form, and approval takes three to five business days.

Skip A Pay is for consumer loans (not credit cards) that are current or within the 10-day grace period. It costs $15 per month, for up to three months, and you must have made 6 payments before your first skip.

Hardship Deferment covers consumer loans and credit cards that are 11 to 60 days past due, once for every 12 payments, with a soft credit pull and income verification. A Due Date Change is for consumer loans after the first payment, within the same month, and the loan must stay current.

help.title: e-Statements
paragraphs: Enrolling in Online & Mobile Banking gives you online access to your statements automatically, and we email you when a new one is ready. To also get statements by mail, turn on the e-Statements switch under Profile & Settings, then Statements Delivery.
For credit card e-Statements, select your VyStar credit card, open the Statements tab, choose e-Statement Enrollment and follow the steps on screen.

help.title: Enroll in Online & Mobile Banking
paragraphs: On the login page or in the VyStar Mobile app, select Enroll in Online Banking and fill in your member information: member number, Social Security number or Tax ID, savings account and ZIP code.
Accept the terms, create a username and password, then verify your identity with a one-time passcode. You should get an email confirming the enrollment.
